#taxid: # Eukaryotic clades with a published NUCLEAR stop-codon reassignment: bins in these clades
# (and bins without taxonomy) are the ones worth classifying with Scribonia.  Outside them no
# reassignment has been reported, which is absence of reports, not proof.  Swart et al. 2016
# (10.1016/j.cell.2016.06.020) found no new code in 265 non-ciliate MMETSP transcriptomes.
# Taxids from NCBI Taxonomy (datasets, 2026-09-27); DOI and claim of every citation checked against the paper.
# stop_sets: which of TAA,TAG,TGA terminate; "ambiguous" = no dedicated stop, context-dependent.
# Contested: Chen et al. 2023 (10.1093/molbev/msad064, stopCR) report TGA = Arg in stichotrichs incl.
# Stylonychia lemnae and TAA/TAG/TGA = Gln/Gln/Cys in Peritromus kahli; not independently confirmed.
# Standard heterotrich: Fabrea salina (Heaphy et al. 2016, 10.1093/molbev/msw166).

known_standard_members: Stentor, rumen Litostomatea, Chilodonella uncinata and other Phyllopharyngea
note: codes differ within classes (Colpodea, Heterotrichea, Phyllopharyngea, Litostomatea); class alone does not predict the code
Hexamitinae (68460: Hexamita, Spironucleus, Trepomonas) TAA/TAG = Gln; Iotanema (1911809, CL3 lineage) TAG = Gln
Streblomastix strix TAA/TAG = Gln; no clean assembly
Dactylomonas venusta (2600585) TAG = Gln, one transcriptome
only Blastocrithidia (28004): UAR = Glu, UGA = Trp, UAA the only terminator
TAA/TAG = Gln in Dasycladales (3134), Cladophorales (3183), Trentepohliales (35443), Blastophysa; TAG = Ser in Scotinosphaerales (1387701); at least 3 independent origins
one uncultured Sainouroidea (2802237) lineage from an insect metatranscriptome, TAG = Leu

known_standard_members: other Amoebophrya strains (control strain ex Akashiwo)
note: only Amoebophrya sp. ex Karlodinium veneficum shown: all three stops likely also sense
